verdict.rationale: Square documents an official first-party MCP server (square-docs-14, confirmed by square-probe-4). This lets users operate Square through natural-language requests in an AI assistant, but only via an external MCP-capable client. Nothing in the pack shows a built-in natural-language assistant or describes which operations the MCP server exposes. missing for 10: native in-product natural-language command interface, documented scope of tools/actions available through the MCP server, independent or hands-on corroboration of natural-language operation working in practice.
